title: Photo displayed was not first project
text: No where on the site does it state the project, candy dispenser, would not be the first project. It arrived late so I printed out a copy of the gift. I would have omitted the photo if it was not the project. I also placed the print out in a card with candy for dispenser. Even though my grandson liked the project he was disappointed. Hopefully, he will enjoy the next one.
